crm_notes:
Summary: Retail catalog search + merchandising team evaluating embeddings + rerank pipeline. Primary objective: reduce irrelevant matches on category pages and increase conversion on peak days (holiday spikes). Team wants cost-per-query model that holds under 5c/query at 95th p90 traffic; tolerance for slightly higher cost for top-10 results if conversion lifts.

Key technical constraints: daily catalog push ~3M SKUs, 2.5M active variants, cold-start upload window overnight (2am-5am PST). Real-time freshness requirement for price/availability changes (sub-minute for checkout flows). Latency targets: p95 < 120ms for search queries; reranker allowed up to 250ms p95 for merchandising endpoints. Must integrate with existing Elastic primary search and use embeddings for semantic fallback + neural reranker.

Model preferences: open model family (llama-2/other open quantized) for reranker; embeddings: 1536-d preferred. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for quantization and batching to meet cost targets.

Security/Compliance: company requires SSO/SAML, KMS integration for key management, audit logs, and data residency in us-west. Planning legal review for any vendor storing PII in vectors.

Commercial notes: initial POC budget approved $30k for 3-month pilot; potential Dedicated contract if POC meets latency + cost guardrails. Procurement expects pricing comparison vs managed vector DB and self-hosted GPU infra.

Customer quotes/requests: "We need predictable cost at scale — holiday season can 8x traffic. If cost model holds, will commit to dedicated pool." — Head of Search (phone 2025-02-27).

Stitched artifacts: POC test harness uploaded to their AWS account (s3://aurora-poc); teams asked for an export of token-level cost breakdown per query and a sample reranker explainability trace.
